mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.sender_id, t.receiver_id, t.partner_id as target_id, t.type, t.content, t.status, t.timestamp, t.is_read, -- 对方的昵称 u.nickname, -- 对方的头像 u.avatar FROM ( SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, type, content, status, timestamp, is_read, -- 核心：确定对话的另一方ID CASE WHEN sender_id = #{id} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS partner_id, -- 窗口函数：按对方ID分组，按时间降序排列 ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{id} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ORDER BY timestamp DESC ) as rn FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{id} OR receiver_id = #{id} ) t -- 关联用户信息表，查出对方的资料 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON t.partner_id = u.user_id -- 只取每个对话伙伴的最新一条记录 WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC;
SELECT * FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (sender_id = #{receiverId} AND receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{offset} , #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
